digest: HMAC-SHA256 under the actual canonical key provider, over OpenAgents Nostr Operation v1, one zero byte, and the complete canonical custody request. The private provider computes this opaque reference; no plaintext hash or key is stored or supplied by the generic UI.
lookup: empty result asks for the existing operation; not-ready is absence, never proof that a prior uncertain write failed
commit: an independently held provider submits its complete public signed/ciphertext candidate; the server validates it and atomically retains the first result for this namespace/operation/digest. Managed results are committed internally by the managed provider, never accepted as caller-supplied replacements.
replay: same intent returns the first committed result; changed action/digest conflicts. Recheck current principal, canonical identity and provider before exposing or using a cached result. A receipt is not a live AUTH/list-read permission.
privacy: no private opening result, secret, nonce, preview or draft is stored; a candidate receipt is not proof of a NIP-59 inner author until the recipient verifies it.
result: coax.native.nostr-result.v1alpha1, custody service and echoed purpose/operation/identity
provider: A linked provider without the installed private digest capability reports not-ready; it never falls back to a public plaintext digest or the server-managed key.
